subtitle: The first place to look before you guess

caption: Every run is here — click one for a step-by-step execution breakdown.

code:
SELECT query_id, user_name, warehouse_name,
       execution_status, error_message, start_time
FROM TABLE(INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY())
WHERE execution_status = 'FAIL'
ORDER BY start_time DESC;
caption: Session-level, 7 days — ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY covers a year, account-wide.

code:
SELECT file_name, status, row_count,
       first_error_message, last_load_time
FROM TABLE(INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COPY_HISTORY(
  table_name => 'RAW.ORDERS_STAGING',
  start_time => DATEADD(hours, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
))
WHERE status <> 'LOADED';
caption: The same load history behind COPY INTO and every Snowpipe run.
